prompt: Why might someone find a pencil note at the stand even though the folded map has not changed?
promptZh: 為什麼摺頁地圖沒變，地圖架上卻可能有鉛筆註記？

options.text: A visitor has requested a new walking route.
options.zh: 有訪客要求增加步行路線。
options.whyZh: 文中沒有把鉛筆註記與路線提案連在一起。

options.text: An update can be posted before it appears on a newly printed map.
options.zh: 最新更正可先公告，再印到新版地圖上。
options.whyZh: 下一批印出前以鉛筆註記傳達更正。

options.text: Changes must be written on every copy by hand.
options.zh: 每份地圖都要手寫修改。
options.whyZh: 文中說註記在地圖架上，不是每張地圖。

options.text: The stand keeps sample walkers’ private records.
options.zh: 架上存放抽樣人員的私人紀錄。
options.whyZh: 註記是給讀地圖的人看的更正資訊，不是個人紀錄。

explanationZh: 下一批印出前以鉛筆註記傳達更正。
evidence: Look for a pencil note on the stand until the next batch of maps is printed.

vocabulary.note: 此處指同一次印製的一批摺頁。

difficultyRationale: 推知手寫註記是改版前傳遞修正的臨時媒介。
